text:
marta: Heads up — we have multiple customer escalations reporting 502s and long tail timeouts for hosted inference in eu-central-1 starting ~21:05 UTC. Ticket #12345, #12346. High 5xx rate on API gateway and increased backend connect timeouts.

ops-bot: ALERT: metric gateway_502_rate exceeded threshold in eu-central-1 (current: 78/min) — https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/xyz

ashok: I can see intermittent BGP flap on ProviderX peering at the eu-central POP. Traceroutes show a hairpin where packets go via their eu-west edge then back -> packet loss ~1-3%, jitter spikes.
traceroute to api-host (sample):
  1  10.3.0.1  0.5 ms
  2  192.0.2.1  2.3 ms
  3  * * *
  4  203.0.113.5  48.1 ms  47.9 ms  48.0 ms  (noticeable RTT jump/hairpin)

kevin: Checking gateway logs + upstream connect logs. Sample from api-gateway-02: 
[21:06:12] upstream_connect_error: dial tcp 10.8.4.21:8080: i/o timeout
[21:06:13] proxy_response: HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway - backend error
Also seeing increased retried streams and long tail latencies on the load balancer.

leila: Can we fail customers over to eu-west-1 temporarily? Many are ok with cross-region fallback for availability, but need opt-in for Dedicated customers.

marta: Support has repro steps from a customer:
support-bot: Repro steps from cust-A:
  1) curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rw-large","prompt":"hi"}' 
  2) After ~6s, gateway returns 502. Response headers below.
  HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
  Server: redwood-gw
  X-Request-Id: rq_abc123

kevin: Quick mitigation — I'm toggling smart-routing to prefer peering B (less flaps) for eu-central ingress while provider escalates. Command: 
``` 
rdbctl routing set --region eu-central --prefer peering=B --duration 30m
```
Applying now.

ashok: I also asked ProviderX to pull BGP logs and confirm no misconfiguration. They acknowledged a microburst and are opening an escalation.

oncall-sre: I'll start a canary to fallback to eu-west for impacted customer groups and enable more aggressive connection retry/backoff on the gateway. Will coordinate with product on opt-in flags for Dedicated.

kevin: Deployed routing tweak + canary fallback for 10% of traffic at 21:28 UTC. Observed 40% drop in gateway_502_rate in first 5m.

ops-bot: ALERT: gateway_502_rate returned to baseline (3/min) in eu-central-1 — resolved at 21:45 UTC.

marta: Thanks team. ProviderX still sees intermittent packet loss, but routing change plus canary fallbacks bought us stability. Opening incident ticket to capture timeline/PCAPs and final mitigation plan. Action items:
  - eng-infra: collect pcap from affected edge hosts (ashok)
  - network: push ProviderX escalation PR #789
  - support: notify affected customers about temporary cross-region fallback and ETA
  - postmortem: include routing policy gap and recommend automated fallback thresholds

kevin: Will follow up with commit hash and exact commands used for routing change.

marta: Posting to #postmortems once we have artifacts. Closing this thread for now. :white_check_mark:
